steps.prompt: A fictional small cab-over harbour freight box truck: flat-fronted short cab with a large windscreen and rounded wind fairing on the cab roof, behind it a tall plain cream-white rectangular cargo box with aluminium corner rails and a roll-up rear shutter, cab painted pale cream, black bumper and side underride rails, plain blank number plates. Vehicle body only with no wheels and no tyres at all: the wheel arches are empty dark openings with nothing inside them, the body shown floating slightly above the floor. Photoreal studio product render of a clean, freshly washed, undamaged vehicle body, physically based materials, crisp panel gaps, high detail. All windows are fully opaque glossy black privacy glass, the interior is not visible at all. Seen from the front-left side at a 30 degree angle, photographed from far away with a long telephoto lens so there is almost no perspective distortion, the whole vehicle small in the frame with generous empty margin. Single isolated object, the entire object in frame with margin, centered, three-quarter front view from slightly above, even soft studio lighting, no cast shadow, plain light-grey seamless background. No text, no logos, no lettering, no numbers, no brand marks, no emblems anywhere on the object.
